title: Local state file (.datamanifest-state.toml) — spec-v4, schema 5
description: JSON Schema for the JSON projection of a .datamanifest-state.toml state file. Parse the TOML to JSON, then validate. The state file is a git-ignored, regenerable per-machine inventory of where each materialized object actually landed: fetched datasets under the `datasets` namespace (storage key -> resolved storage_path + actual sha256) and produced artifacts under `datacache` (cachetype[@version] -> instances mapping a parameter hash to its full artifact directory). It records ground truth (where bytes are), never directives — writes always follow the manifest's current directive. Earlier produced-only `cached.toml` shapes (_META.schema 1-4) are read and migrated forward; this validates the canonical written form, schema 5.

datasets.description: Fetched datasets, keyed by storage key (host/path[#version]) — the dataset's machine-independent identity.

datacache.description: Produced artifacts, keyed by `<cachetype>[@<version>]`. `@` is the reserved version separator; a bare key is the unversioned recipe, so a cachetype may not contain `@`.

dataset.description: A fetched dataset's resolved on-disk record. `storage_path` is where the bytes actually are (ground truth, not the directive); `sha256` is the actual digest of what is on disk, omitted when the dataset sets skip_checksum.

storage_path.description: Resolved on-disk location (relative to the manifest dir when under the repo, else absolute).

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 actually computed from the bytes on disk. Omitted under skip_checksum.

recipe.description: A produced-dataset recipe, identified by its `<cachetype>[@<version>]` table key (never by absolute path). Recipe-level ref/format are refreshed on register (not hash inputs). Params are NOT stored here — they live in each artifact's config.toml sidecar.

ref.description: The producing module:function reference (refreshed across a refactor).

instances.description: One entry per produced variation: parameter hash -> the full artifact directory it was written to (hash included).

additionalProperties.description: The artifact directory the variation was written to (ground truth; relative to the manifest dir when under the repo, else absolute).
